title: fix: shorten Unity catalog description
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Replaces the clipped Unity catalog description with one complete sentence.
- Keeps the root README listing in sync.
- Validated the 860-entry catalog.

gist.headline: Unity gets the whole sentence
gist.blurb: The Unity catalog listing finishes its thought. The README keeps pace, and all 860 catalog entries passed validation.
gist.summary: Replaces Unity’s clipped catalog description with a complete sentence, mirrors it in the root README, and validates the 860-entry catalog.
gist.impact: Readers get a complete Unity description in both the app catalog and README instead of a sentence that cuts off.
gist.visual_concept: Show a cozy app-catalog card labeled Unity beside a matching README page, both bearing a tidy complete line of pixel text. Polli, wearing a tiny editor’s pencil behind one antenna, tends a flowering code-plant between them; no project mascot is identified in the PR.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, a Unity catalog card and matching README page sit beside a flowering code-plant, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), soft pastel gradients, warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) outlines. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium in the scene, wears a tiny editor’s pencil, and carefully straightens the card’s text in a cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic with soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, and retro gaming vibes.
